site.name: NOVVA Colorado Springs, CO (650 Sybilla Ln)
site.label_key: method: climada = CLIMADA worker output; cited = public source / repo-cached public layer / public model API; assumed = our assumption or unverified placeholder

river_flood_depth_p50_baseline.source: SeaBridgeAI climada-stack climada_workers.river_flood (CLIMADA data API, cached hazard sets), run via data/shared/climate/run_climada.py
river_flood_depth_p50_baseline.note: Regional depth over a ~28 km radius (Front Range / Fountain Creek area), not at the site; coarse 150 arcsec global model. CLIMADA worker output is a first-order screening number (percentile of hazard cells within a radius of the site, not a point value); aai_agg uses the repo default exposure value in _damage.py, so USD figures are NOT site-specific loss estimates and are omitted here.

days_tmax_gt_35C_baseline.source: Open-Meteo Climate API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/climate-api), CMIP6 HighResMIP models EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR; computed by data/shared/climate/heat_openmeteo.py; multi-model mean of raw (not bias-corrected) daily Tmax
days_tmax_gt_35C_baseline.note: Future window is 2036-2050 (API ends 2050); future forcing is SSP5-8.5 per Open-Meteo. Coarse 25-50 km grid, no bias or elevation correction: indicative, not site-grade. Per-model values (EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR): [0.1, 0.1, 0.0, 0.0] Colorado Springs sits near 1,830 m; raw models are likely too cool for >35C (observed 95F days are a few per year), so the baseline is biased LOW.

days_tmax_gt_35C_2050.source: Open-Meteo Climate API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/climate-api), CMIP6 HighResMIP models EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR; computed by data/shared/climate/heat_openmeteo.py; multi-model mean of raw (not bias-corrected) daily Tmax
days_tmax_gt_35C_2050.note: Future window is 2036-2050 (API ends 2050); future forcing is SSP5-8.5 per Open-Meteo. Coarse 25-50 km grid, no bias or elevation correction: indicative, not site-grade. Per-model values (EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR): [0.2, 4.5, 0.3, 0.5] Colorado Springs sits near 1,830 m; raw models are likely too cool for >35C (observed 95F days are a few per year), so the baseline is biased LOW.

days_tmax_gt_35C_delta.source: Open-Meteo Climate API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/climate-api), CMIP6 HighResMIP models EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR; computed by data/shared/climate/heat_openmeteo.py; multi-model mean of raw (not bias-corrected) daily Tmax

front_range_reference_days_ge_95F.value: Denver ~5 days/yr now to ~35 by 2050 (high emissions); Boulder ~38-40; Fort Collins ~24
front_range_reference_days_ge_95F.source: https://5280.com/climate-change-a-matter-of-degree/ (Front Range study summary; no Colorado Springs figure found)
front_range_reference_days_ge_95F.note: 95F = 35.0C. A different city; shown because the raw-model Colorado Springs baseline is biased low.

cooling_load_implication.value: Operator claims 8,000+ h/yr of ambient-air cooling and PUE 1.3 (self-reported); more hot days erode free-cooling hours, but the elevation gives large margin. Not quantified.
cooling_load_implication.source: repo data/shared/novva/novva_facts.json (cooling_water) plus the heat delta

wildfire_context.value: Colorado Springs WUI region (2012 Waldo Canyon and 2013 Black Forest fires were nearby); no parcel-level wildfire hazard layer retrieved.
wildfire_context.source: general knowledge, not re-fetched this session

psps_exposure.value: unknown: no Colorado Springs Utilities PSPS programme or event data retrieved

utility_feed.unit: MW (single underground feed, Colorado Springs Utilities)
utility_feed.note: The operator page says both 'single source from utility' and 'dual generation power'; internally inconsistent.

n1_firm_headroom.source: inferred from the single-feed statement in novva_facts.json
n1_firm_headroom.note: No utility N-1 data exists; a single feed implies zero firm headroom, backed by 3 generators now (6 planned).

planned_capacity.value: 30-40 MW PLANNED/ASSUMED, not built; the 252 MW PUC figure is unverified and likely not NOVVA

csu_large_load_rate.value: 2026 Large Load Rate for new customers >10 MW: 10-year minimum agreement, customer-paid infrastructure; grandfathering of the existing 6 MW feed not verified

aqueduct_baseline_water_stress.note: Not retrievable in time: the WRI Atlas/data download was not reachable by API from this session and web search returned no site-level score. Value is an unverified placeholder; replace with an Atlas lookup at the site coordinates.
